steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.enterRoomEditor?.('livingDining'); })()

steps.name: seed
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.addItem({ defId: 'armchair', position: [10.2, 3.6], rotation: 0, props: {} }); s.addItem({ defId: 'armchair', position: [11.0, 3.6], rotation: 0, props: {} }); })()

steps.name: select-both
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const ids = s.items.filter(i => i.defId === 'armchair').map(i => i.id); s.setSelectedItemIds(ids); window.__ids = ids; })()

steps.name: assert-color-changed
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const chairs = s.items.filter(i => window.__ids.includes(i.id)); const colorKeys = Object.keys(chairs[0].props).filter(k => /colou?r/i.test(k)); const anyOrange = chairs.every(c => Object.entries(c.props).some(([k,v]) => /colou?r/i.test(k) && v === '#ff8800')); if (!anyOrange) throw new Error('no color param set to #ff8800: ' + JSON.stringify(chairs[0].props)); if (chairs[0].props.tint !== undefined) throw new Error('parametric got a tint prop (wrong): ' + chairs[0].props.tint); return 'color params set, no tint'; })()

steps.name: assert-reset
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const chairs = s.items.filter(i => window.__ids.includes(i.id)); const stillOrange = chairs.some(c => Object.entries(c.props).some(([k,v]) => /colou?r/i.test(k) && v === '#ff8800')); if (stillOrange) throw new Error('clear did not reset color'); return 'reset to default'; })()
